Evan: Quick note — incoming visitor: Maya Chen (Acme Bios) arriving 9:45am tomorrow. She said she'll bring a small lab monitor and a sample box.
Frontdesk-Bot: Visitor pre-registered: Maya Chen — ACME Bios — 2026-03-30 09:45. Please present ID on arrival. Badge will be printed on check-in.
Mailroom: Parcel for 'Maya Chen / ACME Bios' arrived. Contents: "monitor" + "samples". It's in oversize locker 1. Do you want us to hold it behind desk or label and leave at hotdesk 7? :package:
Evan: Hold behind desk please and tag with arrival time. Also please take a photo and drop it here.
Mailroom: Photo uploaded. Tag: "Maya Chen — HOLD until 2026-03-30 09:30". Placed in locker 1.
Priya: I'll reserve hotdesk 7 by the south window as backup and leave a welcome sticky. @Sam can you print the guest badge at 9:25?
Sam: Yep will do 9:25 print and leave with welcome note (water + granola). Also we have a VGA dongle at supplies if needed.
Evan: Thanks all. No NDA needed — meeting is a product sync. Cheers!
Frontdesk-Bot: Reminder scheduled: print badge 09:25 2026-03-30.
